correctness.rationale: The n maximal (m+1)-vertex cyclic windows of the clique complex have adjacent codimension-one intersection exactly for indices differing by one, under n>=3m+1. The incidence signs on the shared m-face in F_j and F_{j+1} are +1 and (-1)^m, so consistent orientation transport is c_{j+1}=(-1)^(m+1)c_j and monodromy (-1)^{n(m+1)}. The source Wani theorem establishes an m-dimensional triangulated manifold with boundary; Adamaszek Proposition 2.2 gives collapse to C_n and hence M~S1. Poincare–Lefschetz duality with orientation local coefficients gives relative groups Z in degrees m and m-1 for trivial orientation, or Z/2 in degree m-1 for sign monodromy; the pair LES then gives connectivity and exactly the displayed integral groups for m>=4. At m=3 the LES gives connected orientable surface with H1=Z^2 and H2=Z, so PL torus by classification. Independent finite window-incidence checks at (10,3),(11,3),(13,4),(14,4),(16,5),(17,4) confirmed n(m-1) boundary facets, an n-cycle facet dual graph and parity orientation. The proof is universal through cited theorems, not the finite tests alone.
